nightInstructions.otherNights: If the Hatter died, wake the Minions & Demons. Each may choose a new character. If they do, show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.

jinxes.reason: If Legion is created, all evil players become Legion. If Legion is in play, the Hatter has no ability.
The Leviathan cannot enter play after day 5.
If the Hatter dies & the Demon chooses Lil' Monsta, they also choose a Minion to become.
If the Summoner creates a second living Demon, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
